description: Use for "is anything broken right now?" or "any alerts?". Returns when the hourly live check last ran, today so far, open alerts with critical first (for example spend with no sales, a rejected ad, a broken Pixel or store) and, unless include_resolved is false, alerts resolved in the last 7 days. Each alert says why it matters and how to fix it. get_today shows only the top items; this shows them all. Saved data, checked every hour.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

include_resolved.description: Include alerts resolved in the last 7 days.

name: get_live_alerts
